data.narrative:
Space Forge is a Series G-stage space and aerospace company founded by Joshua Western and Andrew Bacon, having raised $22.6M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a sector universe of 5 public comparables (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers including SpaceX, Rocket Lab, and Planet Labs.

Only one valuation method proved applicable given available data constraints. The Stage-Progression method applies a 1.25x step-up multiplier—typical for Series G advancement—to a $9M base value derived from total capital raised, yielding an implied valuation of $11M. The Peer-Median approach could not be executed; while 14 same-sector peers exist, insufficient narrow-set matches (0 same-stage, 1 adjacent-stage) prevented robust triangulation. Public-Comp Anchoring, though the Space & Aerospace sector median trades at 27.4x P/S across the 6-ticker public set, cannot be applied without Space Forge's revenue figure—standard for private company analysis.

The triangulated analysis supports a range of $10M to $13M, with a median of $11M. This estimate carries material uncertainty due to reliance on a single methodological input and absence of revenue-based valuation anchors. Key risks to valuation include the lack of peer comparables at identical stage maturity and the absence of operational metrics typical of later-stage space ventures. Additional disclosure of revenue or concrete contracting activity would materially strengthen conviction in any specific point estimate within this range.
